# I rebuild intelligent systems to understand how "and" whom they learn to trust.

I’m **Mahsa Sirous**, a software engineer and early-career AI researcher working at the intersection of reinforcement learning, multi-agent systems, and trustworthy AI.

This is a living record of the questions I study, the systems I build, and the experiments that survive contact with reality.

::: {.signal-card}
<div class="signal-card__header"><span>ACTIVE QUESTION</span><span class="status-chip">EXPERIMENTING</span></div>

## Can a system learn which AI agents to trust?

Majority voting treats every agent as equally credible. My current work models trust as a learned value so a system can reduce the influence of agents that are confidently wrong.

::: {.metric-row}

<div>
<p class="eyebrow">SIGNATURE EXPERIMENT</p>

## Trust Observatory
</div>
<p>Change the agents’ reliability and watch an online trust estimator adapt. This compact simulation uses an exponential moving average with full-feedback evaluation.</p>
:::

```{=html}
<div id="trust-lab" class="trust-lab" aria-label="Interactive trust learning simulation">
  <div class="trust-controls">
    <label>Reliable agent <output id="reliable-value">88%</output><input id="reliable" type="range" min="50" max="99" value="88"></label>
    <label>Noisy agent <output id="noisy-value">63%</output><input id="noisy" type="range" min="20" max="90" value="63"></label>
    <label>Adversarial agent <output id="adversarial-value">11%</output><input id="adversarial" type="range" min="1" max="60" value="11"></label>
    <label>Rounds <output id="rounds-value">120</output><input id="rounds" type="range" min="40" max="300" step="10" value="120"></label>
    <button id="run-trust" class="btn btn-primary" type="button">Run experiment</button>
  </div>
  <div class="trust-visual">
    <div class="legend" aria-hidden="true"><span class="legend-reliable">Reliable</span><span class="legend-noisy">Noisy</span><span class="legend-adversarial">Adversarial</span></div>
    <svg id="trust-chart" role="img" aria-labelledby="trust-chart-title trust-chart-desc" viewBox="0 0 760 360" preserveAspectRatio="none">
      <title id="trust-chart-title">Learned agent trust over time</title>
      <desc id="trust-chart-desc">Three lines show the learned trust values of reliable, noisy, and adversarial agents over simulation rounds.</desc>
      <g id="trust-grid"></g>
      <g id="trust-paths"></g>
    </svg>
    <div id="trust-summary" class="trust-summary" aria-live="polite"></div>
  </div>
</div>
```
